note: R1 recipe. A step is VERIFIED only when BOTH its contract (declared inputs/outputs)
AND its position in the order are established from evidence. A script having a Usage
line proves the first, never the second — 17 scripts declare contracts, but the ORDER
is documented nowhere in the tree. Steps are added as evidence lands; nothing is
inferred, because a guessed order that runs to completion produces a mod folder that
Author a step by: reading the script's Usage, running it in isolation, recording what
it writes under the mod folder in `produces`, then flipping tier to VERIFIED.

steps.desc: Install the skeleton into model_replacements/ (phase M4/A4)
steps.evidence: docstring states the action and destination; no inputs beyond the repo copy; ordering is definitional — nothing can precede the folder existing

steps.desc: Adapt donor BDL arcs (staging transforms) into arcs/
steps.evidence: CONTRACT known (module docstring), ORDER not: unproven whether it precedes or follows the stage builders. Also pending Housing's lighting-adapter retirement (the normalize_* transforms this step applies may be deleted by that work), so pinning its outputs now would pin a moving target.

steps.desc: Extract donor vegetation blobs to <mod>/assets/veg/ + veg_manifest.ini
steps.evidence: CONTRACT and ORDER both read from the script. Writes assets/veg/<symbol>.bin (:118) and assets/veg/veg_manifest.ini (:132) into a directory it mkdirs (:97). INDEPENDENT: its inputs are the donor executable and framework.map, not any step's output, and it touches no arc. Safe anywhere, re-runnable. veg_manifest.ini is the short-circuit key -- the .bin set is variable, the manifest is one file that describes all of them and is written last.

steps.desc: Bake authored clear-day TEV colours into the sky dome (No116 stopgap)
steps.evidence: CONTRACT and ORDER both read from the script. Rewrites arcs/WwSky.arc IN PLACE (:114), backing up to WwSky.arc.prewhite-bak (:110). ORDER: must run AFTER adapt-bdl-arcs -- its own docstring states it exists to UNDO that step's normalize_tevregs for vr_* materials, where the TEV register IS the sky colour and whitening the placeholder produced the white dome that shipped. ANTI-EDGE: adapt-bdl-arcs must NEVER run after this one; it would re-whiten the dome. 'A before B' cannot express that, same as the shell/grow pair.

steps.desc: Convert donor lighting chain (EnvR/Colo/Pale/Virt) to Env0/Col0/PAL0/VRB0
steps.evidence: CONTRACT and ORDER both read from the script. main() (:389) does three stages -- F_DL01, F_DL02, R_DL01 -- each rewritten IN PLACE at files/res/Stage/<name>/STG_00.arc (:371), backed up to .pre113-bak (:290). ORDER: must run AFTER build-rdl01-shell and after grow-rdl01-stg, because it writes R_DL01/STG_00.arc and addresses rooms 0..5 (:396-404), which only exist once the grow has run. ANTI-EDGE, and it EXTENDS the one Foundry found: build-rdl01-shell rewrites that same STG_00.arc from the R_SP300 template (its own header, :5/:21/:26, says 'must NOT be re-run after'), so a late shell re-run discards the CONVERTED LIGHTING as well as the 6-room stage.dzs. Same file, same mechanism, second victim -- and equally silent.
